summary: Several studies have directly applied gradient boosted trees to energy demand forecasting. Chen et al. (2019) [V0135] used boosted decision-tree ensembles on the FireScope dataset, achieving an accuracy of 0.87. Brennan et al. (2018) [V0134] compared baselines with boosted decision-tree ensembles on ProtMap, reporting an F1 score of 0.8. Duarte et al. (2020) [V0136] reported a MAE of 0.94 on ChurnBench using boosted decision-tree ensembles. Adebayo et al. (2026) [V0133] achieved an AUROC of 0.73 on GridWatch. Additionally, Duarte et al. (2021) [V0013], although focused on septic deterioration, used similar methods on Atlas-ICU, reporting a MAE of 0.93.
